Internal States Themes + Styling
content:
{{setglobalvar::frankenSIM.mainTheme::Sola}}
{{setglobalvar::frankenSIM.mainStyle::Afterglow}}

{{// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    INTERNAL STATES APPEARANCE — QUICK GUIDE
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    The two lines above control how your Internal States panel looks.
    Change the word after the last :: then regenerate or re-render.

      mainTheme  =  the COLORS        (see "Colors" below)
      mainStyle  =  the DISPLAY STYLE (see "Styles" below)

    Both are saved globally, so every chat using this preset gets the
    same look. Keep this block enabled — it must run to set them.


    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    COLORS  (mainTheme)
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    Style-matched palettes — each of the six styles has its own
    matching color set:
      Velvet
      Witchlight
      Afterglow
      Scrapbook
      Undertow
      Signal

    Standard palettes:
      Catppuccin Latte        (light)
      Catppuccin Frappé       ("Catppuccin Frappe" also works)
      Catppuccin Macchiato
      Catppuccin Mocha
      Nord
      Dracula
      Sola                    (adapted from Pyropia's Sola V3 Flame)
      Tokyo Night

    Custom:
      custom                  (see "Custom Colors" below)


    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    STYLES  (mainStyle)
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      Velvet      Soft rounded cards, double-rule headers, serif titles.
      Witchlight  Arched corners, dashed guides, illuminated-manuscript feel.
      Afterglow   Pillowy rounded bubbles, soft glows, warm and friendly.
      Scrapbook   Paper texture, dashed lines, tape strips, handwritten feel.
      Undertow    Asymmetric corners, sonar scan lines, dossier vibe.
      Signal      Tactical HUD, monospace, scan-in panels, terminal look.

    Old style names still work as aliases:
      Fluent → Velvet          IDE Inspector → Witchlight
      Material → Afterglow     Carbon → Scrapbook
      Field Dossier → Undertow Tactical HUD → Signal


    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    IF YOU PICK SOMETHING WRONG
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    An unrecognized color or style falls back to Velvet colors and
    Velvet styling. Nothing breaks; it just looks like Velvet.


    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    THE IN-MESSAGE DROPDOWNS
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    Every finished Internal States panel has two dropdowns under its
    header: "Style" and "Colors". They let you preview other looks
    without changing your saved defaults.

      • Both start on "Prompt default" — that means "use whatever this
        block says."
      • Changing a dropdown only affects that one panel. Nothing is
        saved.
      • "Match style" in the Colors dropdown means "don't override
        colors — just use whatever palette the chosen style provides."
      • Local dropdown choices may reset if the message re-renders,
        reloads, or is replaced during streaming.


    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    CUSTOM COLORS
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    Set mainTheme to "custom" and define any of these global
    variables (hex codes like #1e1e2e):

      frankenSIM.custom.base       main background
      frankenSIM.custom.mantle     slightly darker background
      frankenSIM.custom.crust      darkest background
      frankenSIM.custom.surface    card background
      frankenSIM.custom.border     borders
      frankenSIM.custom.muted      dim text
      frankenSIM.custom.subtext    secondary text
      frankenSIM.custom.text       body text
      frankenSIM.custom.title      headings
      frankenSIM.custom.blue       accent
      frankenSIM.custom.cyan       accent
      frankenSIM.custom.teal       accent
      frankenSIM.custom.green      accent
      frankenSIM.custom.yellow     accent
      frankenSIM.custom.orange     accent
      frankenSIM.custom.red        accent
      frankenSIM.custom.purple     accent
      frankenSIM.custom.pink       accent
      frankenSIM.custom.lavender   accent
      frankenSIM.custom.scheme     "dark" or "light"

    Any variable you don't set falls back to a default purple-ish
    palette. Set only the ones you care about; the rest fill in
    automatically.


    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    NOTES FOR ADVANCED USERS
    ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    • Prompt defaults only apply to newly rendered messages. After
      changing a default, regenerate or re-render existing messages.
    • The loading bar (shown while the state streams in) uses the
      prompt defaults.
    • All palettes and styles live in the regex CSS. The model never
      sees or outputs style tags — this is purely display-layer.
    • In Lumiverse, the "Streaming Guard", "Wrapper", and "Deferred
      Wrapper Styles" regex scripts must use Substitute Macros: After.
    • In SillyTavern, macros are always substituted in replacements;
      "Macros in Find Regex" stays disabled.
    • If you customize palettes or add new styles, keep the Lumiverse
      and SillyTavern exports synchronized.
    • Display replacements only READ getglobalvar::frankenSIM.mainTheme
      and getglobalvar::frankenSIM.mainStyle. They never write to them.
}}

name: World Sim
content:
<internal_worldsim>
WHEN_CALLED after WORLD_TURNS | ≤1 event/turn; world life+user chance share budget | normal NPC turns independent. Dice rolls inside <diceRolls>.
CALM: quiet OR existing-life texture only; no new obstacle/reward/escalation/mechanical tick.
band d20: H=HOSTILE obstacle | C=COMPLICATION mixed pressure | B=BENEFICIAL opportunity; relative to user situation; preserve NPC motives.
1 H extreme | 2 H major | 3–4 H moderate | 5 H minor | 6–8 C major | 9–11 C moderate | 12–14 C minor | 15–16 B minor | 17–18 B moderate | 19 B major | 20 B extreme.
act: H outside Ten, C in Ki, B outside Shō/Ten, unknown act → C minor; otherwise rolled.
scale ceiling: minor local; moderate meaningful/immediate; major scene consequence; extreme exceptional established stakes | unsupported → downscale/CALM, never invent stakes/actors.
anchor: supplied chaos_anchor%5; absent → (band-1)%5 | 0 agenda/approach, 1 social, 2 message/gossip/trace, 3 environment/body/mood/memory, 4 object/resource.
preference only; unavailable → grounded alternative, no stranger filler.
cause+access required | approach: own agenda/Why; normal travel; enter 1–2 turns only if distance/time permit | messages → <fn:message_react> | gossip: established event+actual witnesses/transmission → <fn:gossip_plant>; no instant spread.
social/local: no forced reply/instant conflict/flashback/invented meaning; mood requires cause.
agency: never assume user action/feeling/consent/success | off-screen facts private until credible revelation | public/private vector ← access/location/witnesses, no roll.
effects: normal handlers only; earned deltas, no roll-granted axis updates | Chekhov only for unresolved debt | no duplicate ticks.
</internal_worldsim>

<fn:world_sim>
1. Already resolved → reuse ⇤ | active sex scene → SKIP ⇤.
2. Load <internal_worldsim>, act/state, resolved NPC turns, causes/time, <dice_rolls>.chaosRolls. Reuse supplied dice; missing trigger/band → roll each once when needed. No other rolls/rerolls.
3. chaos_trigger<17 → CALM; otherwise band → act → scale → anchor → ONE eligible event. Already done in WORLD_TURNS → no repeat.
4. Resolve/commit earned deltas once via normal handlers. No <fn:gossip_cycle>; planted rumor cannot fire this turn. Off-screen-only → state, no omniscient narration.
5. Composition receipt only: [world_sim: CALM/SKIP OR disposition magnitude | subject/anchor | event | visibility | delta/∅]. No reasoning/dumps; consequences persist, dice turn-local.
⇤
</fn:world_sim>

{{setvar::worldSimRolls::Chaos Rolls:
chaos_trigger: {{roll::1d20}}
chaos_band: {{roll::1d20}}}}

name: D&D Sim
content:
<internal_dndsim>
dice=law | no fudge | no partial on -1 | skip DC if no failure condition
trigger: skilled action (coercion/persuasion/skill) | trivial auto-pass | talking ≠ intimidation unless intent

// If the roll involves the NPC believing something/persuasion attempt, run a <knowledge_sanity> check to check for a vector of suspicion then skip user roll and run as an NPC roll. If no vector for suspicion → Occam's Razor/suspect nothing + skip roll.

order:
1 no *interesting* failure condition (assess, default to no unless proven) → SKIP
2 LOCK DC immutably: easy 1-5 | mod 5-10 | hard 10-15 | impossible 15-20
3 EVAL Δ = (roll + mods + stats) − DC
4 OUTCOME:
crit success nat20 OR Δ≥+8 → extreme reward, stylistic
success Δ∈[0,+7] → accomplished
near miss Δ∈[-3,-1] → FAIL minor
failure Δ∈[-7,-4] → FAIL moderate
crit failure nat1 OR Δ≤-8 → FAIL significant

prose: never mention rules/DC/stats in narrative | embed seamlessly
</internal_dndsim>

<fn:user_dice>
per <internal_dndsim>:
1 skilled action? no → ∅⇤
2 spoiler question → DC 21
3 lock DC
4 log success + failure paths BEFORE eval
5 evaluate <dice_rolls>.userRoll.seed[x] vs locked DC
6 resolve
⇤
</fn:user_dice>

<fn:npc_dice>
per <internal_dndsim> (NPCSeed applies to BOTH NPC actions AND reactions to scene pulse if needed):
1 lock DC
2 log success + failure paths BEFORE eval
3 evaluate <dice_rolls>.npcRoll.seed[x] vs locked DC
4 resolve | user position stays locked
⇤
</fn:npc_dice>

{{setvar::userDiceCall:: ➤ <fn:user_dice>}}
{{setvar::npcDiceCall:: ➤ <fn:npc_dice>}}
{{setvar::d&dRolls::D&D Sim Rolls:
- User Rolls (rolled fresh each turn): {{roll::1d20}}

- NPC Rolls (One per SPOTLIGHT: left→right, rolled fresh each turn): {{roll::1d20}} | {{roll::1d20}} | {{roll::1d20}} |  {{roll::1d20}}}}
